split_policy.primary_axis: behavior phase before conformance suite bucket, corpus surface row, manifest row, workflow label, generated artifact, evidence-log row, migration-only row, compatibility row, or retired-surface claim
split_policy.positive_rule: conformance positives are canonical Objective-C 3 behavior only after parser, sema, lowering, IR, runtime, or e2e owners claim them; buckets, corpus surface rows, manifests, coverage maps, workflow labels, report artifacts, and provenance rows are not behavior support by themselves
split_policy.provenance_rule: corpus surface rows, bucket inventories, manifest inventories, coverage maps, gap models, claim policies, workflow commands, report paths, tmp artifacts, schema paths, docs/runbook/tutorial pointers, generated-only rows, evidence-log rows, and migration-only rows are provenance until a phase owner claims behavior
split_policy.retired_surface_rule: old-mode, shim, fallback, compatibility, unsupported, known-open, generated-only, evidence-log, migration-only, dashboard-only, prose-only, schema-only, workflow-only, tmp-artifact-only, claim-policy-only, and alternate acceptance path cases are canonical rejection, strict-error, known-open, tracking-only, or provenance-only evidence
split_policy.bucket_rule: parser, semantic, lowering_abi, module_roundtrip, diagnostics, examples, spec_open_issues, workpacks, coverage gap states, longitudinal suite rows, workflow surfaces, and artifact surfaces are storage, reporting, or provenance buckets, not support owners
